subject: The Mustang Way
overview: Students and school staff presented reflections on the core values of the Mustang Way, focusing on respect, responsibility, and community. Center for Citizenship and Social Responsibility program coordinator Michael Skorker concluded by encouraging students to incorporate kindness and empathy into daily life.

items.title: Defining the Mustang Way
items.summary: Students and staff reflected on the principles of the Mustang Way, emphasizing mutual respect, empathy, good citizenship, and positive effort both inside and outside of school.

items.title: CCSR Closing Remarks
items.summary: CCSR Program Coordinator Michael Skorker concluded the assembly, highlighting the organization's mission to promote kindness, empathy, and resilience while encouraging students to practice the Mustang Way daily.
